local scn, done = ...
for _, e in ipairs(ents.FindByClass("prop_physics")) do e:Remove() end
local bot = player.GetBots()[1]
local start, ang = Vector(700, -600, -143.6), Angle(0, 90, 0)
local calls, samples, thinks, t = {}, {}, {}, -30
local function rec(cls, what, extra)
  local e = { t = t, w = cls, call = what }
  if extra then for k, v in pairs(extra) do e[k] = v end end
  calls[#calls+1] = e
end
local function mk(cls, auto, delay, clip)
  local S = {}
  S.Base = "weapon_base"
  S.Spawnable = false
  S.ViewModel = "models/weapons/c_pistol.mdl"
  S.WorldModel = "models/weapons/w_pistol.mdl"
  S.Primary = { ClipSize = clip, DefaultClip = clip, Automatic = auto, Ammo = "Pistol" }
  S.Secondary = { ClipSize = -1, DefaultClip = -1, Automatic = false, Ammo = "none" }
  function S:Initialize() self:SetHoldType("pistol") rec(cls, "Initialize") end
  function S:Deploy() rec(cls, "Deploy", { next = self:GetNextPrimaryFire() - CurTime(), clip = self:Clip1() }) return true end
  function S:Holster(wep) rec(cls, "Holster", { to = IsValid(wep) and wep:GetClass() or "" }) return true end
  function S:Think() thinks[cls] = (thinks[cls] or 0) + 1 end
  function S:PrimaryAttack()
    rec(cls, "Primary", { clip = self:Clip1(), next = self:GetNextPrimaryFire() - CurTime(), can = self:CanPrimaryAttack() })
    if not self:CanPrimaryAttack() then return end
    self:TakePrimaryAmmo(1)
    self:SetNextPrimaryFire(CurTime() + delay)
  end
  function S:SecondaryAttack()
    rec(cls, "Secondary", { next2 = self:GetNextSecondaryFire() - CurTime() })
    self:SetNextSecondaryFire(CurTime() + 0.5)
  end
  function S:Reload()
    rec(cls, "Reload", { clip = self:Clip1(), ammo = self:GetOwner():GetAmmoCount(self.Primary.Ammo), next = self:GetNextPrimaryFire() - CurTime() })
    self:DefaultReload(ACT_VM_RELOAD)
  end
  weapons.Register(S, cls)
end
mk("parity_semi", false, 0.2, 6)
mk("parity_auto", true, 0.2, 5)
local function held(tk)
  if tk >= 10 and tk < 70 then return IN_ATTACK end
  if tk == 80 or tk == 90 or tk == 100 or tk == 120 or tk == 122 then return IN_ATTACK end
  if tk >= 140 and tk < 150 then return IN_ATTACK2 end
  if tk == 160 then return IN_RELOAD end
  if tk >= 220 and tk < 280 then return IN_ATTACK end
  if tk >= 290 and tk < 310 then return IN_ATTACK end
  return 0
end
hook.Add("StartCommand", "parity_swep", function(ply, cmd)
  if ply ~= bot then return end
  cmd:ClearButtons() cmd:ClearMovement()
  cmd:SetButtons(held(t))
  cmd:SetViewAngles(ang)
end)
hook.Add("SetupMove", "parity_swep", function(ply, mv, cmd)
  if ply ~= bot then return end
  if t < 0 then mv:SetOrigin(start) mv:SetVelocity(Vector(0,0,0)) mv:SetButtons(0) else mv:SetButtons(held(t)) end
end)
hook.Add("Think", "parity_swep", function()
  t = t + 1
  if t == 0 then
    bot:Give("parity_semi")
    rec("parity_semi", "Give", { ammo = bot:GetAmmoCount("Pistol") })
    bot:SelectWeapon("parity_semi")
  end
  if t == 200 then
    bot:Give("parity_auto")
    rec("parity_auto", "Give", { ammo = bot:GetAmmoCount("Pistol") })
    bot:SelectWeapon("parity_auto")
  end
  if t >= 0 then
    local w = bot:GetActiveWeapon()
    samples[#samples+1] = { t = t, active = IsValid(w) and w:GetClass() or "", clip = IsValid(w) and w:Clip1() or -2,
      ammo = bot:GetAmmoCount("Pistol"), next = IsValid(w) and (w:GetNextPrimaryFire() - CurTime()) or 0 }
  end
  if t == 330 then
    for _, h in ipairs({ "Think", "StartCommand", "SetupMove" }) do hook.Remove(h, "parity_swep") end
    done({ calls = calls, samples = samples, thinks = thinks, tick = engine.TickInterval() })
  end
end)
return "async"
